//: Preferred vendoring = these pinned deps (all permissive: Apache-2.0 / MIT / BSD-3 / ISC — verified 2026-08-06). Source-pinned git-submodule alternative is documented in ../submodules/PLAN.md §A. leonardo is the OSS lib, NOT the paid Adobe CC product.
//deps: 2026-08-07 expansion — all permissive (MIT/ISC/Apache-2.0), license-verified: open-props (MIT) = breadth of ready-made design tokens (color/space/type/easing/shadow/gradient) complementing our seeded generator; culori (MIT) = fast, tree-shakeable color-space math (OKLCH/OKLAB/P3/Delta-E) alongside colorjs.io/chroma-js; motion (MIT, formerly Framer Motion / motion.dev) = the OSS motion engine we standardize on INSTEAD OF non-OSI GSAP; @iconify/json (MIT wrapper; individual sets keep their own permissive licenses) = the offline icon-data engine feeding the iconographer; lucide (ISC), @tabler/icons (MIT), @phosphor-icons/core (MIT) = concrete permissive icon sets on top of Iconify; pagedjs (MIT) = print / paged-media (CSS Paged Media polyfill) for PDF/print output. EXCLUDED (do not add): GSAP (non-OSI 'no-charge' license with redistribution/competitor restrictions — not OSS), tints.dev (fine as a hosted tool but we prefer local culori/chroma ramps), Animate.css (MIT but a prebuilt CSS grab-bag that undercuts the seeded/motion approach), Vivliostyle (AGPL-3.0 copyleft — kept out of the vendored tree; Paged.js is the MIT print path). Non-OSI/paid items are named here so nobody re-adds them.
